scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:assistant"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client/platform && pip install -r server/requirements.txt
scripts.install:all:unix: npm install --prefix client/platform && pip3 install -r server/requirements.txt
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev:server:ngrok" "npm run dev:platform" "npm run dev:assistant"
